description: This source file contains unit tests for the ModelCatalogLoader in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing the parsing and loading of model data from TypeScript source snippets.

classes.name: ModelCatalogLoaderTests
classes.description: A struct containing asynchronous test methods for loading and parsing model catalog data.

methods.name: `load parses models from type script and sorts`
methods.description: Asynchronously tests parsing models from a TypeScript string, writing it to a temporary file, and verifying the loaded choices contain expected models, sorted as specified.

methods.name: `load with no export returns empty choices`
methods.description: Asynchronously tests loading from a TypeScript source with no exported models, expecting an empty result.
